create_csm_model: create a CsmForConditionalGeneration model for audio-text conditional generation with a backbone and depth decoder
run_csm_forward_pass: run a forward pass on CsmForConditionalGeneration with input_ids, input_values, and labels for training
merge_audio_text_inputs: merge input_ids and input_values into inputs_embeds using _merge_input_ids_with_input_values in CsmForConditionalGeneration
generate_audio_codebooks: generate audio codebook tokens autoregressively using CsmDepthDecoderForCausalLM with a position-specific codebooks head
prepare_generation_inputs: prepare inputs for generation with prepare_inputs_for_generation in CsmForConditionalGeneration handling audio-text merging
